subject: Commit snapshot & churn-risk ledger: BlueHorizon renewal
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@bluehorizon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Commit snapshot & churn-risk ledger: BlueHorizon renewal

Hi Elena —

Following our Q2 planning call, we ran a quick commit snapshot and noticed a few coverage gaps that could materially affect your renewal ARR if not reconciled before the end of month. Attached is a one-page summary and a CSV with line-level commit flags we used for forecasting.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm whether the usage spike for "Data Enrichment Pipeline" is expected to continue past June? If yes, we should mark that seat count as a soft-commit.
- Any procurement timeline constraints we should model (PO, internal approvals)?

If it's helpful I can schedule a 20-min reconciliation with your finance lead this week.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment stubs: BlueHorizon_Renewal_Summary_Q2.xlsx (xlsx), commit_snapshot_20280412.csv (csv)

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@bluehorizon.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procure-team@bluehorizon.com
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit snapshot & churn-risk ledger: BlueHorizon renewal

Connor —

Thanks for the summary and the flags. Quick answers: the Data Enrichment Pipeline usage is trending up because of a pilot with a new partner; we expect it to continue through Q3 but not at the same growth rate. Procurement is slow this quarter; likely PO by late-May but internal approvals might be staggered.

I'll sync with finance and loop in our FP&A lead if you want to get ahead of modeling. Can we do Thu, Apr 14 at 11am PT?

—Elena
Head of Customer Success | BlueHorizon Solutions

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Commit snapshot & churn-risk ledger: BlueHorizon renewal

Connor / Naomi —

I reviewed the CSV and added confidence tags: green / amber / red based on usage signal + renewal health notes. High-level:
- Data Enrichment Pipeline: amber (pilot exposure, needs PO timing)
- Integrations bundle: red (several open bugs + accounts on limited plan)
- Core inference seats: green but velocity slowed this quarter

I'll prepare a short packet to present on the 14th. Naomi — can you pull the last 6 weeks of token-level cost deltas so we can show delta impact if the pilot scales? Ben, please confirm if sales can offer a 60-day flexibility clause to reduce churn risk while procurement finalizes.

Marissa
Renewal Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachment stub referenced: commit_snapshot_20280412.csv

Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit snapshot & churn-risk ledger: BlueHorizon renewal

Marissa —

Uploading the token-cost export to the shared Drive now (link added below). Preliminary numbers show a ~18% cost increase month-over-month attributable to the pilot; I'll break out per-namespace so we can present clear delta scenarios (best / expected / worst).

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/bluehorizon-renewal-q2

Will have a refreshed sheet by EOD Monday.

Naomi

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2028 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit snapshot & churn-risk ledger: BlueHorizon renewal

Elena —

Thanks for confirming timelines. Confirmed for Thu 14 at 11am PT was tight for your team so we moved to Fri 15 at 2pm PT and I booked a 30-min slot for a short reconciliation with FP&A + procurement. Agenda: 1) reconcile commit CSV rows, 2) agree on soft-commit markers for pilot usage, 3) define procurement milestones and fallback cadence.

I've attached the one-pager we'll walk through and a cleaned snapshot. If procurement prefers a PO + staged payments, we can model two scenarios and recommend an interim 60-day credit hold to reduce churn risk.

See you Fri — Connor
Attachment stubs: BlueHorizon_Renewal_Summary_Q2.xlsx, commit_snapshot_20280412.csv

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@bluehorizon.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit snapshot & churn-risk ledger: BlueHorizon renewal

Connor / team —

Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround and for pulling the cost deltas. Procurement confirmed a probable PO by 5/26; they asked that we model both full-commit and staged-commit (50/50) scenarios. FP&A will join the Friday call.

One more ask: can you include a suggested rollback path if pilot usage drops after August (we want to avoid surprise overage billing while procurement is still underway).

Elena
Head of Customer Success | BlueHorizon Solutions
